summary: Boasting a refined, sculptural form the new Hyde series of rimless toilets sets a new benchmark in balancing high-end design and functionality.
title: Hyde Has Arrived: The New Contender In Rimless Design
bodyHtml:
The New Hyde Suite- 375 x 635 x 835 mm

A Sculptural New Toilet Series

Hyde is the latest addition to our Rimless toilet collection, offering a sculpted, refined profile that feels right at home in today's design-conscious bathrooms.

Its soft, organic form brings a sense of calm and balance—serving as a subtle statement piece without overwhelming the space.


Hyde Wall Faced Pan - 370 x 565 x 445 mm

Quiet Confidence, Powerful Performance

Engineered with a high-performance rimless flush, Hyde delivers a powerful yet efficient flush cycle while maintaining a 4-Star WELS rating.

The absence of a traditional flush rim ensures improved hygiene and effortless cleaning—both inside and out, whilst minimising splashing often seen in poorly designed rimless toilets.


The New Hyde Suite with CleanMax Anti-Bacterial Glaze

Considered Functionality for Everyday Ease

very Hyde toilet is enhanced with our CleanMax Anti-Bacterial Glaze, reducing the build-up of grime and bacteria while simplifying maintenance over time.

Designed for daily ease without compromising visual integrity, Hyde achieves a rare harmony between form and function.


The Hyde Wall Faced Pan - Powerful yet water efficient 4 Star flush
